scope: Re-run of local.access.qualify.20261028, whose raw report was lost: scripts/qualify_access_changes.py on a frozen Debug build of 2d5aa7c (D:/wp/b65) in one owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN (V21), 214/215 steps: webserver_page_set, certificate_create, certificate_assign, certificate_delete, certificate_import, umac_role_set, vci_workspace_create and vci_workspace_delete each applied with exact preview assertions, checkpoint, compile and save, change_status, and a complete before/after state (every block, type and tag-table export plus certificate_inspect, access_inspect, web_inspect and vci_workspace_inspect) that differs in exactly the intended keys, with recorded web activation side effects (TIA's web server certificate); typed refusals per kind changed nothing; a fresh owned Portal reopened the project with an identical state and every journal applied; one further change per kind was restored by change_restore to the exact pre-change state. Created WebServer certificates were re-issued by the compile with the requested common name and validity end kept.
limitations: One owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN with its local certificate store; the global certificate store, other CPUs, HMI devices and UMC servers are not exercised.

certificate_assign writes only PlcCommunicationCertificate on the store-owning CPU; WebserverCertificate, OPC UA attributes and null unassignment are not written. certificate_inspect renders certificate attributes display-only, so the assigned Id is read back through typed refusals (AssignmentDrift currentCertificateId, CertificateInUse references).

Certificates are created with usage WebServer and one Dns alternative name. The persisted identity after the device compile is compared with the request and recorded under certificateIdentity; the wave 10 probe saw the compile re-issue a created certificate (CN-only subject, new serial and notBefore, the CPU address as alternative names), and a mismatch lists the kind under notQualified.
certificate_import imports the public DER of a certificate this run created and deleted; PEM, CA-issued and foreign certificates are not imported natively.

umac_role_set: one custom role, one device function right taken from the scratch's custom role and one active project user; engineering function rights are never granted or revoked (no read tool lists the available ones), so AdministratorLockout is not exercised; anonymous and UMC principals are untouched.
webserver_page_set writes webServerActive and systemWebPages; defaultApplication is only refused (stale or missing application), never written.
Switching web serving on or off is allowed to change the CPU's web- and certificate-named attributes and to add or remove certificates in its store; these side effects are recorded under sideEffects.
VCI workspaces are created in the root workspace group without mappings, with roots outside the artifact store and the project; change_restore never restores workspace files.
Not covered here: vci_mapping_add, vci_mapping_remove, vci_synchronize.
Engineering only; nothing is downloaded and runtime behavior is not observed.
webserver_user_pages_generate is not qualified by this run: generation also added a system constant to the default tag table, which its preview does not declare.

The reopen comparison step failed only on WebserverApplicationName and WebserverHTMLDirectory, the CPU web attributes written by webserver_user_pages_generate's application, which read differently after a fresh reopen; that kind stays unqualified, as in the original run.
